result.title: Fully sequential Gaussian process regression for preference learning
result.summary: We study continuous global optimization problems in which the objective function cannot be directly evaluated; rather, we observe only which of two selected design points appears to perform better, subject to noise. Such comparisons complicate the use of Gaussian process regression because they yield non-Gaussian posteriors. We consider a fully sequential approximation, based on moment-matching, that yields a fast closed-form update of the metamodel's mean and covariance. We then propose DOVE, a fully sequential sampling policy that combines an information gain criterion with randomized sampling designed to control error accumulation. Under fairly standard regularity conditions, we prove convergence rates for both statistical error and expected simple regret that depend on kernel smoothness. To our knowledge, these are the first such rates for fully sequential approximate Bayesian inference in continuous global optimization.

AI.brief_summary: 针对只能观测噪声成对比较、无法直接评估目标函数的连续全局优化问题，提出基于矩匹配的全序列近似高斯过程回归（均值和协方差有闭式快速更新），并给出结合信息增益与随机采样的采样策略 DOVE，在正则条件下证明统计误差与简单遗憾的收敛率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其顺序近似贝叶斯更新、信息增益驱动的采样准则与误差累积控制，可能为 LVR 中信念/推理状态的增量维护、证据获取与停止决策提供概念类比，但该工作无视觉或多模态成分，迁移路径仅供核查。
